description: Figure: gene-level LoF tolerance versus regional missense constraint in KRT9
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

q = """query{ gene(gene_symbol:"KRT9", reference_genome:GRCh38){
  variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ consequence hgvsp genome{ ac an } exome{ ac an } } } }"""
vs = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q},
                   headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}, timeout=180).json()["data"]["gene"]["variants"]
rows=[]
for v in vs:
    h=v.get("hgvsp") or ""
    m=re.search(r"p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)([A-Z][a-z]{2})$", h)
    if not m or m.group(1)==m.group(3) or v.get("consequence")!="missense_variant": continue
    ac=sum((v[k]["ac"] or 0) for k in ("exome","genome") if v.get(k))
    rows.append(dict(pos=int(m.group(2)), wt=m.group(1), mut=m.group(3), ac=ac))
mis=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates(subset=["pos","wt","mut"])
L=623
print("unique gnomAD missense:", len(mis))

regions=[("head",1,152),("coil 1A",153,188),("L1",189,207),("coil 1B",208,299),
         ("L12",300,322),("coil 2",323,461),("tail",462,623)]
cv_path={"head":0,"coil 1A":20,"L1":0,"coil 1B":0,"L12":0,"coil 2":1,"tail":1}
con=pd.DataFrame([("KRT9",0.000),("KRT1",0.000),("KRT10",0.000),("KRT14",0.000),("KRT5",0.611),
 ("KRT16",0.000),("KRT6C",0.000),("COL7A1",0.000),("FLG",0.001),("TP53",1.000)],columns=["gene","pLI"])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.8))
d=con.sort_values("pLI")
cols=["#b03030" if g=="KRT9" else ("#2f6f4e" if g=="TP53" else "#bbbbbb") for g in d.gene]
axes[0].barh(np.arange(len(d)), d.pLI, color=cols)
axes[0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(d))); axes[0].set_yticklabels(d.gene, fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_xlabel("gnomAD pLI"); axes[0].axvline(0.9, ls="--", color="k", lw=0.9)
axes[0].set_title("KRT9 pLI = 0.000, with 34 observed\nloss-of-function alleles in gnomAD")

names=[r[0] for r in regions]
dens=[((mis.pos>=a)&(mis.pos<=b)).sum()/(b-a+1) for _,a,b in regions]
pdens=[cv_path[n]/(b-a+1) for n,(_,a,b) in zip(names,regions)]
x=np.arange(len(names)); w=0.38
axes[1].bar(x-w/2, dens, w, color="#3b6ea5", label="gnomAD population missense")
axes[1].bar(x+w/2, pdens, w, color="#c0392b", label="ClinVar pathogenic")
axes[1].set_xticks(x); axes[1].set_xticklabels(names, rotation=25, fontsize=9)
axes[1].set_ylabel("variants per residue")
axes[1].set_title("Coil 1A is depleted of population missense\nand loaded with pathogenic alleles")
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8.5)

win=40; centers=np.arange(win//2, L-win//2)
dd=np.array([((mis.pos>c-win//2)&(mis.pos<=c+win//2)).sum()/win for c in centers])
axes[2].plot(centers, dd, color="#3b6ea5", lw=1.6)
axes[2].axhline(len(mis)/L, ls=":", color="k", lw=1)
axes[2].text(455, len(mis)/L+0.06, "protein-wide mean", fontsize=8)
for a,b in [(153,172),(440,461)]: axes[2].axvspan(a,b,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.18)
axes[2].text(163, dd.max()*0.95,"HIM",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#c0392b")
axes[2].text(450, dd.max()*0.95,"HTM",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#c0392b")
axes[2].set_xlabel("residue position"); axes[2].set_ylabel("missense per residue (40 aa window)")
axes[2].set_title("Population missense dips at both helix boundary motifs")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

h=((mis.pos>=1)&(mis.pos<=152)).sum()/152; c1a=((mis.pos>=153)&(mis.pos<=188)).sum()/36
print(f"head {h:.3f}/aa vs coil 1A {c1a:.3f}/aa = {h/c1a:.2f}x")
print(f"sliding-window minimum {dd.min():.3f}/aa at residue {centers[dd.argmin()]}; mean {len(mis)/L:.3f}/aa")
